name: agent-workbench-template
description: A host-agnostic starter kit for a personal workbench side panel: four modes, two rows of filters, a full-width list, a Markdown reader, and an editable annotation layer.

scripts.check: node --check server/server.mjs && node --check core/app.js && node --check core/host.js && node --check core/markdown.js && node --check adapters/openchamber/panel/main.js
scripts.test: npm run check && npm --prefix adapters/openchamber run check && npm --prefix adapters/openchamber run check:manifest && npm --prefix adapters/openchamber run check:parity && npm --prefix adapters/openchamber run test:plugin
